about: Machine-readable work queues for the six workstreams. GitHub Issues hold each story; this file says which story each workstream is on, what comes next and what blocks it. The orchestrator thread updates it at the weekly review and when a lead reports a story done. Check and render with: python docs/product/operations/tools/queues.py all

rules.needs_chris: New user-facing features need a mockup and Chris's typed go; Fabric capacity or cloud spend needs his typed yes. Such stories are blocked, never ready, until he answers.

KF-FABRIC-SPARK.title: Fabric Spark interactive sessions (Livy) as a Preview engine
KF-FABRIC-SPARK.problem: Notebooks that need real Spark can only run as a whole Fabric job; there is no interactive Fabric Spark session from the app.
KF-FABRIC-SPARK.capability: A Preview engine that runs cells in a Fabric Spark session through the Livy API, with remote-compute confirmation.
acceptance: The saved patch is rebased onto main and opened as a draft PR
Every remote session start goes through the remote compute confirmation and risk check
Tests with Fabric faked cover start, run, cancel and stop
Docs say it uses Fabric capacity and is Preview

KF-SNOWFLAKE-RESEARCH.title: Snowflake pillar: audit, ADRs and parity matrix
KF-SNOWFLAKE-RESEARCH.problem: Snowflake is one of the three target platforms and has no work at all.
KF-SNOWFLAKE-RESEARCH.capability: An evidence-based plan: what Snowflake development can run on the PC (DuckDB with a Snowflake SQL dialect, SQLGlot transpiling, Snowpark local testing), what needs a live account, and how it fits the existing engine registry and connection profiles.
acceptance: A parity matrix like databricks/parity-matrix.md, with official sources for each row
ADRs for sign-in, the engine adapter and what never runs inside the engine process
A sliced plan of independently reviewable PRs
No code and no Snowflake account spend before Chris's go

KF-DBX-LOSS-REPORT.title: Databricks notebook conversion says what it could not carry over
KF-DBX-LOSS-REPORT.problem: Importing or exporting Databricks notebooks drops widgets, magics and dbutils calls without telling the developer.
KF-DBX-LOSS-REPORT.capability: A loss report on every Databricks import and export, extending the existing converter (no second converter).
acceptance: Each dropped or changed construct is listed with its cell
Round-trip tests cover widgets, %sh, %fs and dbutils
Docs list what converts and what doesn't
